extracted.name: Baja Salad
extracted.description: For this Mexican-style Baja salad recipe, corn, black beans, avocado, and tortilla chips are tossed with romaine lettuce in a homemade lemon dressing.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup crushed tortilla chips, or to taste
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine romaine, tomato, avocado, cucumber, feta cheese, onion, corn, and black beans in a large bowl; toss well. Sprinkle tortilla chips over salad.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until dressing is smooth; drizzle over salad and toss to coat.
